purpose: Resolve the selected own-bar close-location concept into one exact no-value mechanism and challenge it against the terminal and prospective families before any Campaign022 source partition, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return is opened.

selected_mechanism.name: intraday_intrabar_close_location_pressure_240m
selected_mechanism.formula: (L-U)/(L+U), where L=sum_i(log(close_i/low_i)) and U=sum_i(log(high_i/close_i)) over exactly 240 continuous-session bars
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: A larger range-normalized excess of close-to-low distance over high-to-close distance means that transactions repeatedly finish near the upper part of their own minute ranges. Persistent within-bar demand acceptance may carry into the next three sessions.
selected_mechanism.selected_bar_grid: exactly 240 one-minute bars at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00 after frozen timestamp normalization; standalone 09:30 is excluded
selected_mechanism.bar_rule: Every selected high, low, and close must be finite and positive with exact low<=close<=high. A zero-range bar contributes zero to L, U, and the denominator and stays in fixed support.
selected_mechanism.aggregation_rule: Use the ratio of the two full-day summed log distances; never average per-bar close-location ratios and never weight by time, range, volume, or amount beyond the formula's own log-distance denominator.
selected_mechanism.missing_rule: Any invalid, nonpositive, or misordered selected high/low/close; fewer than 120 positive-range bars; nonpositive total log range; nonfinite component or score; or score outside [-1,1] makes the stock-day missing.

overlap_challenges.reason: The terminal body-range factor divides absolute close-open displacement by high-low range and discards the direction of the close within the bar. Campaign022 reads no open and preserves whether the close is nearer the high or the low.

The low-coverage terminal Campaign013 factor locates transaction VWAP within the bar and requires amount/volume compatibility. Campaign022 forbids activity and transaction VWAP, locates the observed close instead, and is not a field-repair or tolerance change to Campaign013.

Campaign015 compares the current close with the previous bar's closed interval across within-half transitions. Campaign022 compares each close only with its own simultaneous high-low interval, uses no prior bar, and is invariant to bar ordering.

Those factors depend on close-to-close path order, endpoint position in the day's close range, or adjacent return signs. Campaign022 uses no adjacent close and remains unchanged when the 240 complete bars are permuted.

Those factors use high-low interval geometry, time order, or range magnitudes without the close's signed location inside its own bar. Holding all high-low intervals fixed while moving closes within them changes Campaign022 and leaves those range-only factors unchanged.
Campaign019 and Campaign016 require open-close bodies or interbar gaps. Campaign022 forbids open and does not form adjacent pairs.
Campaign022 uses no cross-stock benchmark, lagged market return, beta, residual, or peer threshold. It measures own-bar acceptance geometry rather than common-information timing.
Campaign022 reads no volume, amount, transaction price, quarterly value, disclosure timing, or event field.

Candidate49 measures causal cumulative transaction-VWAP crossings using close, volume, and amount. Campaign022 uses high/low/close only, no cumulative path or crossing count, and may not evaluate Candidate49 returns.

counterfactual_independence_tests: Permuting all 240 complete bars leaves Campaign022 unchanged but generally changes close-path efficiency, return signs, terminal close location, prior-range breakout, gap-body confirmation, and Campaign021 lead-lag values.
Holding every high-low interval and transaction VWAP fixed while moving each close within its own interval changes Campaign022 but leaves range-only and transaction-VWAP-envelope factors unchanged.

Holding every close path fixed while asymmetrically widening each bar above or below its close changes Campaign022 but leaves close-only return, market-response, and Candidate49 crossing values unchanged.
Holding high, low, and close fixed while changing open, volume, amount, market peers, or announcement history leaves Campaign022 unchanged.
prohibited_variants: replace logarithmic distances with arithmetic distances, per-bar ratios, bins, thresholds, counts, entropy, regression, rank correlation, or another denominator
use open, transaction VWAP, amount, volume, adjacent bars, path endpoints, market peers, subwindows, or the standalone 09:30 row
drop zero-range bars, change the 120-positive-range support, add containment tolerance, or change endpoint canonicalization after values
change direction, invert, filter, rewindow, year-select, board-select, industry-select, or combine the factor after returns
backfill or compare Candidate49 historical returns
